name: dated-exceptions
trigger: The first time a rule of the contract must be broken for a while: a residency rule waiting for a contract, real data allowed in one measurement, a check switched off during a migration.
adds: exceptions.json and a check that fails the day an exception expires, so that a temporary state cannot become the regime by being forgotten.
limits: It proves the date, not that the code behind the exception was removed: the entry says which test must turn red.
Renewing an exception is a change to exceptions.json, reviewed like any other: say why the first date was missed.
